name_reason: Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '03' is the chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs), not a Ghidra address residue. Name accurately reflects the chapter 3 init handler dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table.
purpose: Chapter 3「往塞拉村途中」init handler: a flat chapter-prologue orchestrator that re-inits battle state, plays 4 dialog pages chained with 3 cutscenes, loads portrait set 1, and pans the camera before handing the chapter off to the player.
logic_summary: Re-inits battle state, then runs a straight-line prologue: pan camera + delay, dialog page 0 (battle_anim_phase=0), cutscene 0x12, load portrait set 1, pan + delay, cutscene 0x11, dialog page 1 (battle_anim_phase=0), cutscene 0x13, dialog page 2 (battle_anim_phase=0), pan camera, dialog page 3 (no reset, tail), clear all char facings, pan camera to char 0. No char init -- party carries over from chapter 2. In the binary the page-3 dialog call + trailing clear-facing/pan are a tail-JMP into the shared epilogue at 0x3312D (also reached by chapter init at 0x33049); the straight-line src is the functionally-equivalent Layer-2 reconstruction.

returns.semantics: No return value; init handler invoked for side effects (drives the chapter-3 prologue scenes and battle-state setup).

notes: src comment block (chinit.c lines 244-274) is already accurate, precise, and ASCII -- describes the flat orchestrator, 4 dialog pages + 3 cutscenes (0x12/0x11/0x13), portrait set 1, battle_anim_phase resets, Layer-2 tail-JMP into 0x3312D, and linked handlers; matches the decompilation exactly, so comment kept. Ghidra plate was updated only because it was stale: it named the delay call __delay_thunk_375b2 (live name is fd2_delay_ms) and lacked the Layer-2 tail-JMP detail. xref source 0x51d79 confirmed to be inside the chapter-03 entry of the handler table at 0x51d70 (LE dword 0x32e8c at table offset +8). set_plate_comment returned 'missing Algorithm/Parameters/Returns section' warnings -- these are doc-template advisories, not errors.
